title: The Rotor's spool follows its barrels; Isao's study screen shows the owner's synthetic-learning panels after the Quiver beat
context: Owner: fix the Rotor spin sound, it should follow the barrels. And after the second set of enemies falls to the Quiver, a screen where Isao explains the aliens communicate via vibrations and he is reverse-engineering it but needs more compute, showing the synthetic-learningx58 screens as little modals.
outcome: Rotor: a looped minigun_ready voice per mount whose gain and pitch ride tw.spinRate (with a distance falloff), started above 3% spin and stopped below it; voices stop with destroyTower and the board reset; the one-shot cue at state changes is gone. Study: the seven x58 panels and their CRT helper vendored unmodified under vendor/synthetic-learningx58; src/fx/synthetic-modal.js renders them in a modal with Isao's lines, pausing the game, CONTINUE or Escape closing it; beats enter `study` three seconds after `settled` (STORY_QUIVER.studyDelay) with the vibration_study brief and api.screen('synthetic'). A first run left a transparent sheet over the strip after closing (the modal's display rule beat the hidden attribute); a [hidden] rule and an assertion on computed display fix and guard it. Controller at 17,609.
alternatives: A dedicated spin loop sample: deferred, the ready cue looped and pitched reads as the motor; a purpose-made loop would be better and is one file away.
evidence: npm test 93 (beats through study), npm run check
browser --story-world PASS: screen opens and pauses, seven panels, CONTINUE resumes and the strip works again; --dist legacy PASS
